topic: Vehicle Usage Mode and Exterior Light Control System Specifications
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific system or mode parameter with its associated values and definitions.
column_semantics: The table uses merged cells to define parameters, their possible values (in hexadecimal), and descriptive labels for each value. The first column lists the parameter names, while the subsequent columns provide detailed definitions and value mappings.

core_entities.name: VehMdV
core_entities.description: Vehicle Mode Validity status, indicating whether the vehicle mode is valid or invalid.

core_entities.name: UsG Md
core_entities.description: User-Ground Mode, representing different operational modes of the vehicle such as Sleep, Standby, Comfortable, Normal Driving, AI Parking, AI Pilot, and XOTA.

core_entities.name: UsG MdV
core_entities.description: User-Ground Mode Validity status, similar to VehMdV but specific to user-ground modes.

core_entities.name: ExteriorLightControlSystem.ControlCombinedLight
core_entities.description: Function to control the combined light (near light) of the vehicle, including turning it on or off.

core_conditions.name: VehMdV_0_Invalid
core_conditions.description: Indicates that the vehicle mode is not valid.

core_conditions.name: VehMdV_1_Valid
core_conditions.description: Indicates that the vehicle mode is valid.

core_conditions.name: UsG Md_2_Comfortable
core_conditions.description: User-Ground Mode in Comfortable driving state.

core_conditions.name: UsG Md_3_NormalDriving
core_conditions.description: User-Ground Mode in Normal driving state.

core_conditions.name: UsG Md_4_AIParking
core_conditions.description: User-Ground Mode in AI Parking state.

core_conditions.name: UsG Md_5_AIPilot
core_conditions.description: User-Ground Mode in AI Pilot state.

core_conditions.name: UsG Md_6_XOTA
core_conditions.description: User-Ground Mode in XOTA (eXtended Over-The-Air) update state.

core_conditions.name: UsG MdV_0_Invalid
core_conditions.description: Indicates that the User-Ground Mode is not valid.

core_conditions.name: UsG MdV_1_Valid
core_conditions.description: Indicates that the User-Ground Mode is valid.

core_outputs.name: ExteriorLightControlSystem.ControlCombinedLight
core_outputs.description: Controls the activation or deactivation of the vehicle's near light.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the valid states and modes for vehicle usage and exterior light control, which can be used to verify the correct behavior of the vehicle's mode management system and the exterior light control function under various operational conditions.
uncertain_points: The exact timing or sequence of mode transitions is not specified in this table.
The interaction between different modes (e.g., AI Parking and AI Pilot) is not detailed.
The specific implementation details of the CAN/LIN/SOA service/line are not provided.
